activity.title: Hey David, just sent a connection request! I’d love to connect, discuss this opportunity, and share my resume.

I am delighted to share an important personal achievement – last week I successfully defended my dissertation and earned the degree of Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Computer Science 🎓 I would like to thank everyone who supported me along the way: ✨ My supervisor, Anatolii Anisimov – for guidance and mentorship; ✨ The members of the examination committee – for their thorough review and valuable feedback; ✨ My alma mater, Taras Shevchenko National University of Kyiv – for the opportunities and knowledge I received during my studies; ✨ University of Cambridge – for the great research experience during my visiting program; ✨ My family and friends – for their unwavering support and belief in me. I also want to extend my gratitude to the defenders of Ukraine, whose courage allows us to study, work, and grow 🇺🇦 This day marks the completion of an important stage in my academic journey, and the beginning of a new chapter in my life! #OpenToWork

I’m thrilled to share that I have graduated from the University of Cambridge with a BA in Computer Science and will soon be continuing my studies with an MSc in Data Science at The University of Edinburgh . The past few years have been a period of intense learning and personal growth, and I’m deeply grateful to everyone who has supported me along the way. It has been an incredibly inspiring journey. During my time at Edinburgh I will delve deeper into data analysis, statistics, and machine learning. This next chapter offers an amazing opportunity to expand my knowledge and skills, and I look forward to the collaborations and experiences that lie ahead.

𝗩𝗼𝗹𝗼𝗱𝘆𝗺𝘆𝗿 𝗖𝗵𝘂𝗯’𝘀 math journey started at age eight in his hometown of Kharkiv, 🇺🇦 #Ukraine . At first, he struggled to keep up with classmates. But with support from his parents and a change in teachers, he reached the regional Olympiad level and kept going up. What motivates him? "First, the spirit of the competition—the process before and during is very exciting because you're anticipating it, then sitting down to solve the problems," he said. "Second, as you prepare and solve problems that are just slightly above your ability, each one feels like a little journey. It's exciting to work through them and figure out the solution path." The journey led Volodymyr to earn a 🥉𝗯𝗿𝗼𝗻𝘇𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝗱𝗮𝗹 𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟯 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗠𝗮𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗢𝗹𝘆𝗺𝗽𝗶𝗮𝗱 (𝗜𝗠𝗢). Since then, he has stayed involved with students at his old school. With all his years of training, his advice to younger competitors may be surprising: "Many top mathematics and programming Olympians began just two or three years before finishing school and still became much better than those who trained for ten years. So… just live your life, and then maybe in the middle of high school, if you realize it's fun for you, you still have time to dive in." Volodymyr is now studying 𝗠𝗮𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗰𝘀 𝗮𝘁 Jesus College Cambridge . He is excited about the independence and diversity of university life. 𝗢𝘂𝘁𝘀𝗶𝗱𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗵: ⚽ Plays football with friends and has good intuition for the game ♟️ Loves chess, though admits he plays a bit too much 🎾 Enjoys tennis and swimming 👥 Likes sports that bring people together

I’m proud to share that I’ve recently completed the academic program as a Visiting Postgraduate Research Student at the University of Cambridge Department of Computer Science and Technology . It’s been a journey of learning, collaboration, and research — and I’m excited to carry these experiences into future challenges and projects. I’m especially grateful to my supervisors, Professor Simone Teufel and Dr. Yiannos Stathopoulos, for their invaluable mentorship and support throughout this time. I’ve learned a great deal about shaping ideas into meaningful research and gained a deeper understanding of the academic process. Over the past few years, I’ve grown as both a researcher and an initiator of educational programs, and I’m eager to continue developing in both directions. But the journey isn't over just yet! While I prepare for my viva, I’m also stepping into a new chapter – I’m happy to share that I will remain affiliated with the Department, and I am planning to use this time to further deepen my work in AI and continue collaborating with the incredible academic community here, while helping to build connections with my home institution Taras Shevchenko National University of Kyiv .
